bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 68 (Thursday, April 18, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. McCOLLUM:
H.R. 8074.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Section 8 of article I of the Constitution.
The single subject of this legislation is:
To phase out production of perfluoroalkyl or
polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) over 10 years while
maintaining exemptions for essential PFAS, prohibit non-
essential PFAS production and releases of such substances,
and for other purposes.
[Page H2522]
